claim: Every reader of the approval rules reads one price, and the approval seal covers it: ADR 0244 D3, the founder's answers 8-10 of 2026-09-30, verbatim picks "Use the larger figure (Recommended)", "Match the re-check (Recommended)", "Add unit price, versioned (Recommended)". (8) settings/approval-thresholds.service.ts readOrdersUnderTest (the register's how-often-would-each-rule-have-fired) counts on effectiveTotal, max(total_cost, unit price x quantity), imported from procurement/order-price-recheck.ts, not restated. (9) The price-jump rule measures the order's unit price down the re-check's chain (final, negotiated, quoted) in the approve act (assertApprovalAllowed), the /orders walk (walkOrdersUnderTest) and the register; an order with no final price is no longer exempt; the comparison is still with the last price PAID, so only a final price enters the history. (10) The approval seal (order-seal.ts orderSealArgs, ORDER_SEAL_VERSION 2, tagged sealVersion) covers the total, the vendor and the chain's unit price, each a fixed-precision string with unknown hashed the same at both ends; issueOrderSealChallenge mints version 2 only; redemption also accepts the version-1 shape of the same row (orderSealArgsV1, total and vendor) through SealChallengeService.redeem legacyArgs, so a hold opened before the deploy can finish within its 2-minute TTL; assertRedeemed accepts no legacy shape; the cancel seal is unchanged; ADR 0116 is bracketed. Behaviour: 7 REVERT-FAILS cases across order-seal.spec.ts, order-approval-gate.spec.ts and settings/approval-thresholds.spec.ts, all red on 9c20fd0e3 (#542's head), plus 5 unmarked cases pinning version-1 holds, unknown prices and never-paid prices; 16 of 16 mutations killed (4 for answer 8, 5 for 9, 7 for 10). This verify: 20 reasons on 9c20fd0e3, and 22 of 22 tripwire mutations (each reader's money, chain and paid history, the register's import, the seal's unit price, tag, v1 shape, chain, legacy total, version-2 mint, legacy redeem in the service and the seal service, the record check staying strict, three spec pins, both ADRs) each reported, 2026-09-30.
